stories.title: Man to serve two years in jail over Ballymena riots
stories.summary: Adam Tweed, 21, of Dalriada Walk in Ballymena was described in court as an "active and persistent" participant in rioting in the town in June 2025.

stories.title: 'Mummy's death was preventable, she was robbed of her future'
stories.summary: Lillian Diamond died weeks after she underwent an elective splenectomy surgery at the Mater Hospital.

stories.title: New Brexit deal 'won't solve' all issues, but is a 'step in the right direction'
stories.summary: The agreement is expected to be confirmed when Andy Burnham and Ursula von der Leyen meet in Brussels.

stories.title: Legendary Irish League manager Coyle dies aged 80
stories.summary: The Irish League's most successful manager Roy Coyle dies at the age of 80.

stories.title: Sean Graham bookmakers memorial vandalised for third time
stories.summary: The plaque was also painted over in September and October in what police described as "sectarian" offences.

stories.title: Striking doctors warn staff will leave NI for better pay
stories.summary: A full 24-hour strike began at 07:00 GMT - the second such action taken by doctors this year.

stories.title: Bishop orders review into handling of concerns about paedophile priest
stories.summary: The review will examine how the Derry Diocese dealt with concerns about Fr Edward Gallagher, beyond the 109 child sex offences he admits.

stories.title: What is it like to be Jewish and living in Ireland?
stories.summary: BBC News NI speaks to Jewish people about what it is like to live in the Republic of Ireland.

stories.title: 'Better results for patients' since SWAH surgery suspended, says health chief
stories.summary: Emergency general surgery was temporarily suspended at SWAH in December 2022.

stories.title: Fine Gael leader wants border poll criteria talks with London
stories.summary: Simon Harris says a conversation between the British and Irish governments over the criteria for a border poll would be "useful".

stories.title: Irish government denies 'foot-dragging' over Omagh Bombing Inquiry
stories.summary: Sir Chris Bryant urged Irish ministers to hold an inquiry when they met for the British Irish Intergovernmental Conference.

stories.title: Rape and child sexual abuse arrests in church investigation
stories.summary: Two arrests as part of an investigation into the Presbyterian Church in Ireland, were in relation to sexual communication with a child and rape.
